hotels.title: Victoria Lakeside Escape near Black Bull Golf Course with Daily Breakfast, Wine Tasting & Spa Session
hotels.description: Surrounded by river red gums and Lake Mulwala’s gentle waters, lakeside luxury awaits on the south bank of the Murray River. Swim in the heated pool or fish the day away before returning to the resort's Stock & Barrel restaurant for country-inspired plates and handpicked spirits. Those who golf together will adore the 18-hole championship Black Bull Golf Course - consistently rated one of the country’s best. After a day on the greens, take a trip to SOL Wellness Spa, offering holistic treatments drawing on foraged Australian active ingredients.
